headline: Paul Yoon’s Fierce Attachment to His Dog Inspired a New Novel
context: Prompted by a fierce attachment to his own pet, Paul Yoon wrote a harrowing yet hopeful novel, set during wartime, told from a canine perspective.

sources.name: The New York Times
